integrity_notes: The compactness, quasinilpotence, and commutant obstruction are proved explicitly in the result.
Independent audit has not been performed.
A related 1985 weighted-shift paper was accessible only through its bibliographic record and abstract; it is retained as a literature-comparison risk, not used to justify noncoverage.
scientific_limitations: The result supplies a counterexample to universal existence of a two-link commuting chain ending in rank one; it does not classify all compact quasinilpotent operators.
It does not rule out longer chains or chains with a higher-rank compact endpoint.
title: A compact quasinilpotent weighted shift with no two-step rank-one commuting chain
